shown.message:
Version 3 is merged into `release` (2c971c7), so it is no longer waiting on anything. `internal-review-repo` approved it with a short list of changes for `final`. I've made the ones in my paths and handed the rest to `figtab-repo`. I haven't checked the official `document` build.

**Done on `dev` (c5ba798, also `candidate-draft-16`, no pull request opened yet):**
- **M9:** Appendix B now says "specified before the runs" in place of "pre-registered".
- **M10:** the abstract and introduction now say the graph network has a lower RMSE than the regression, with a paired interval below zero, in 5 of 13 cells (threshold mechanism). The abstract adds "untuned". I did not add the 50-draw count to either; the introduction bullet dropped it for page fit.
- **M11:** the main text now says "8–14 times the width of HC0" is by stratum of |bias|/SD.
- **M12:** the appendix now names the nine groups as the null column and mechanisms (a)–(h). The other two group counts were already named: 10 (eight mechanisms and two families) and 24 (mechanism by family).
- **Unconfirmed wording:** I couldn't tell from `results/p6/p6_cells.csv` which cells are the 666, so the "nine groups" naming rests on there being nine mechanism columns. The reviewer's M12 request has not been checked against it, and I haven't asked `experiment-repo` to confirm.
- **Page fit:** these additions pushed the Discussion onto page 10. To bring it back to 9 pages, I cut the oracle-rule sentence (right in 98.3% of 1974 cells) and the "both in 54 (69%)" and "(79%)" cluster counts. I also cut the "thinning also changes clustering" limitation and the list of absolute R² values, which now points to Table 2. A local build ends the main text on page 9 with 0 undefined references.

**Open:** M8 is `figtab-repo`'s. `CAPTIONS.md` and `REPRODUCE.md` section 9 still number the cluster figure 10 and the new P6 figure "(P6)", where the paper has 10 = P6 interval and 11 = cluster designs. I opened `figtab-repo`#6 and posted the status on #12.

**Next:** once M8 lands on `dev`, I'll cut one candidate into `main` for the owners of the changed paths to approve. After that I'll offer `main` to `final`, which releases the world.
